images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original aggregate-edition landing background for Reveal Line's DroneAid NL community, distinct from all six workshop campaign close-up images.
Input image role: MATERIAL, MOOD AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new wide neighborhood overview, not another workbench close-up.
Primary request: a warm Dutch canalside maker-community campus at blue-hour dawn, viewed from a sheltered workshop terrace. Across a small canal, several connected brick gabled workshops and an open community courtyard glow with amber lamps. Windows reveal modest maker benches; small covered crates and bicycles sit by the quay, a pedestrian bridge links the buildings, and a small civilian quadcopter rests safely on a pad on the foreground-right terrace. Subtle warm light trails along walkways suggest a supportive network. Welcoming and calm, no combat.
Style: polished richly detailed game environment illustration with realistic warm wood and red brick, navy and muted teal evening air, restrained copper lamp light, visual depth; keep clear quiet silhouettes and crisp details rather than photorealistic noise. Landscape 1536x1024.
Composition: left 40 percent is deeply shaded navy interior doorway and timber wall, low-detail and suitable behind a game menu; the campus panorama and bridge sit in right 60 percent. Main lit courtyard at 67 percent horizontal and 55 percent vertical must survive a narrow portrait crop. Sky and canal form breathing room. No large foreground human figures.
Constraints: entirely new overview composition, no flags, text, lettering, numbers, labels, logos, UI, borders, watermark, weapons, military scene or emergency. Opaque illustration suitable for separate subtle ambient drone/light animation.
images.referenceRole: Style and palette reference only; new overview composition
